decisions.reason: The perfect binder sits squarely within the firm's long-standing binding and finishing expertise, so its specialist technicians and service organisation can interpret customer feedback and keep the product competitive without in-house R&D.

The fully automatic perfect binder builds on existing binding knowledge and fits the firm's strategic push toward integrated automation, making it valuable to retain and refine through supplier and group capabilities.

The inline/nearline booklet maker extends the firm's core bookletmaking competence and supports its digital print finishing direction, so the firm's absorptive capacity allows it to assimilate market feedback and sustain the product.
